mapper.select: SELECT process_no FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND SUBSTRING(process_no, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]{6,19}$' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(process_no, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS DECIMAL(20,0)) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_key = #{businessKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 1 AND status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED', 'REJECTED', 'TERMINATED', 'INVALIDATED', 'CANCELLED') FOR UPDATE

SELECT archived_instance.instance_id FROM wf_process_instance archived_instance WHERE archived_instance.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND archived_instance.deleted = 1 AND archived_instance.instance_id > #{afterId} AND archived_instance.status IN ('PASSED', 'AUTO_PASSED', 'REJECTED', 'TERMINATED', 'INVALIDATED', 'CANCELLED') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_gateway_activation activation WHERE activation.tenant_id = archived_instance.tenant_id AND activation.instance_id = archived_instance.instance_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_parallel_join arrival WHERE arrival.tenant_id = archived_instance.tenant_id AND arrival.instance_id = archived_instance.instance_id)) ORDER BY archived_instance.instance_id LIMIT #{limit}
